_meta.note: Consensus / estimated metrics for the pre-earnings brief. Figures are analyst-estimate and house assumptions, NOT confirmed company guidance. Refresh as sell-side notes land closer to Jul 17. Loaded by earnings_tracker.load_earnings_preview('SCB.BK').

net_profit_h1_2026_bn_thb.note: Estimate range; FY2025 net profit ~THB 44-45bn. H1 typically ~50-52% of full year.

net_interest_margin_pct.note: BOT policy rate held at 1.00% supports funding cost; NIM compression risk if BOT eases later in 2026. Watch loan-yield vs deposit-cost spread.

npl_ratio_pct.note: Asset quality watch: SME and unsecured consumer book. Coverage ratio expected ~160%+. Any uptick >3.5% would be a negative surprise.

loan_growth_yoy_pct.note: Muted system loan growth given Thailand GDP ~1.5% 2026. Quality over volume.

cost_to_income_ratio_pct.note: Digital/Gen2 (virtual bank, InnovestX) investment spend vs core bank efficiency.

h1_2026_interim_div_est_thb.note: Interim dividend usually announced WITH H1 results (Jul 17) or shortly after; ex-date est. ~Sep 2026. FY2025 total was THB 11.28 (final THB 5.64 paid May 7).

dividend_outlook.payout_policy: SCB X targets high payout (~80%+); attractive for Tho's income-oriented medium-term hold.

key_watch_items: NIM direction vs BOT rate path (hold at 1.00% is supportive; any dovish BOT pivot pressures NIM).
NPL ratio and credit cost — unsecured/SME book is the main asset-quality risk.
H1 interim dividend declaration (size + ex-date) — primary catalyst for a yield holder.
Gen2 business (virtual bank, InnovestX, digital assets) losses vs core-bank earnings.
Capital ratio / CET1 and any buyback signal.

scenario_reaction.beat: Net profit > THB 25bn AND interim div >= THB 6.0 → likely positive re-rating toward upper 52w range (145-149.50). Reinforces high-yield thesis.
scenario_reaction.inline: Net profit ~THB 23-24bn, div ~THB 5.5-5.75 → muted reaction; yield support keeps price range-bound 135-142.
scenario_reaction.miss: NPL > 3.5% OR div cut below THB 5.0 → downside toward 125-130; reassess yield-trap risk.

advisory_note_for_tho: SCB is a high-yield medium-term hold. The Jul 17 release is the single most important catalyst this quarter. The pre-earnings brief (triggers Jul 14) should remind Tho NOT to add aggressively into the print given binary div/NPL outcomes, and to treat any beat-driven dip-buy opportunity below THB 130 as the preferred entry. This is informational, not a recommendation to trade.
